# PanePilot v0.12.0

PanePilot 0.12.0 streamlines the workspace and makes terminal recovery more deliberate.

## Highlights

- Project tools now sit in the centered status bar, secondary commands live in one
  compact overflow menu, and frequently used actions can be pinned back to the top
  toolbar on this PanePilot client.
- Local persistent terminals and chats recover on demand after a computer restart,
  packaged builds consistently load their bundled interface, and tmux discovery
  preserves and repairs Unicode terminal names.
- Project Q&A and the separate terminal archive have been retired. Upgrading stops
  and removes PanePilot's legacy Q&A session records and saved output while preserving
  provider-owned Codex archives; deleting an ordinary terminal still requires
  confirmation and preserves provider archives.

## Download

The attached DMG and ZIP support Apple silicon Macs running macOS 12 or newer.
`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains SHA-256 checksums for both downloads. PanePilot has no
automatic update channel; install new versions from this repository.

PanePilot Remote for Android remains available as source under `android/`; this
release does not include a signed Android APK.

Stable latest-release link: [github.com/Salazar-Prime/PanePilot/releases/latest](https://github.com/Salazar-Prime/PanePilot/releases/latest)

## First launch

This desktop build is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized. After copying
PanePilot to Applications, Control-click it in Finder, choose **Open**, and confirm
the launch. Do not disable Gatekeeper. Download PanePilot artifacts only from this
GitHub repository.
